newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends higher but off day's highs.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends higher but off day's highs.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures ended higher but off their intraday highs as mill buying faded late, traders said.

Harvest delays in Kansas, mill buying and ideas the market had been oversold provided the market with early support. But traders said the supportive factors gave way to harvest-related selling late in the session.
"We had our bounce and then just petered out," a KCBT trader said.
KCBT wheat settled 1-1/2 to 3-1/2 cents per bushel higher, with July up 2-1/2 cents at $3.39-1/2 a bushel.
It was the first time the July contract had closed in positive territory since June 11, when July gained 1/2 cent to settle at $3.87-1/2.

Traders said volumes were active, with ADM's Benson-Quinn buying one million bushels each of the July, September and December contracts. Refco sold 2.2 million Sept. E. D. & F. Man International sold 1.8 million Sept and bought 1.3 million Sept and 1.2 million Dec.
Wolcott Lincoln bull-spread 2.5 million July/Sept bushels at 6-1/2 to seven cents.
